name: AVIC Leihua Electronic Technology Research Institute (LETRI)
aliases: AVIC Leihua Electronic Technology Research Institute

evidence.summary: The US Military End-User List names it among seven subordinate institutions of AVIC that the US government determined to be military end users, in December 2020. AVIC is one of the state-owned defence-industry groups that SASTIND lists, and says its businesses include aviation weapons and equipment and military transport aircraft.
It belongs to AVIC, which describes itself as a very large state-owned enterprise managed by the central government.

sources.title: Addition of ‘Military End User’ (MEU) List to the Export Administration Regulations and Addition of Entities to the MEU List (85 FR 83793, 23 December 2020)
sources.publisher: US Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security (Federal Register)
